model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance comparison of different Llama models with and without fine-tuning (FT) across a range of values on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with numeric values ranging from 20 to 28, with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled with numeric values from 4 to 8, also on a linear scale, with a tick label interval of 2. The plot contains four lines representing different models: Llama-3B (blue solid line), Llama-3B + FT (green dashed line with triangle markers), Llama-1B (light blue solid line), and Llama-1B + FT (light green dashed line with triangle markers). The blue line (Llama-3B) starts at approximately (20, 4.2) and increases steadily to around (28, 8.2). The green dashed line with triangle markers (Llama-3B + FT) closely follows the blue line, starting at about (20, 4.5) and rising to roughly (28, 8.3). The light blue line (Llama-1B) begins at around (20, 4) and increases to approximately (28, 7.8). The light green dashed line with triangle markers (Llama-1B + FT) starts at about (21, 4.5) and reaches around (28, 8).
